items.quote: you are, Mr. Agent, actually the one who is triggering the potential buyer to tell you, just send me some option.
items.statement: Real estate agents often trigger buyers to request options via ineffective questioning.

items.quote: with the stupid question like, oh, do you like Dubai? Which area in Dubai do you want to invest?
items.statement: Agents frequently ask vague questions like, 'Do you like Dubai?' which may confuse potential buyers.

items.quote: what you need, you need to look at his own meeting. So ask him a different question which is in the description.
items.statement: Instead of asking vague questions, agents should ask more targeted questions to clarify buyers' needs.

overview: A brief instructional transcript discussing strategies for real estate agents to improve client engagement and reduce reliance on vague requests for options during meetings.
